linkedin_url.description: Accepts an array of company URLs. Acceptable inputs: www.linkedin.com/company/contactout, contactout, https://www.linkedin.com/company/27927, 27927. Cannot be used with other search filters. (array, max:25)

name.description: Accepts an array of company names (array, max:50)

domain.description: Accepts an array of company domains (array, max:50)

size.description: Company size by number of employees. Accepted values list (array)

hq_only.description: Filter search locations by headquarters only (boolean)

location.description: Accepts an array of locations (array, max:50)

industries.description: Accepts an array of industries. Accepted values list (array, max:50)

technologies.description: Accepts an array of technology names (array, max:50)

min_revenue.description: Minimum revenue of the company Accepted values list (integer)

max_revenue.description: Maximum revenue of the company Accepted values list (integer)

year_founded_from.description: Minimum year founded of the company (integer, min:1985)

year_founded_to.description: Maximum year founded of the company. Requires year_founded_from. (integer, max: current year)
